equivalent_mutants.reason: Checked original 0x48300b CMP EAX,99, 0x48300e JA and 0x483010 MOV EAX,99. Changing <=99 to <99 differs only for EAX==99, when either branch leaves EAX==99. No outside call or memory store occurs inside this clamp, and original EFLAGS are not an output of this ordinary owner. Every later observable value and published x87 state is identical.

Checked original 0x48417f FSTP qword [ESI+0x60] followed by 0x484182 FSTP ST(0). The mutant delays only the high-word publication of the already-computed stored bits until after the register-only discard. That discard has no guest-memory operand, cannot read or change the pending word or computed value, and is followed only by return. Both final memory words, x87 stack/status and return remain identical; no original observer intervenes.
